hero_heading: Joining Little Sparks is simpler than you'd think.
hero_text: Four steps, most families are done within two weeks. No exams for anyone under 6 — just a friendly visit and a conversation.

steps.title: Book a visit
steps.text: Walk through a real classroom, meet the teachers, and see a normal school day in action.

steps.title: Submit the form
steps.text: A short form with your child's age, any allergies, and your preferred program.

steps.title: Meet-and-greet
steps.text: A relaxed 20-minute chat between your child, a teacher, and you — no tests involved.

steps.title: Welcome aboard
steps.text: Confirm the seat, pick a start date, and we'll send over a settling-in guide.

fees_subtext: Fees include meals, materials, and all regular activities. No hidden charges.
cta_heading: Seats fill up early in the year.
cta_text: Reach out today and we'll set up a visit within the week.
